item.title: New Canaan Man, 50, Charged with Disorderly Conduct
item.description: New Canaan Police on Feb. 26 arrested a 50-year-old Forest Street man by warrant and charged him with disorderly conduct. The warrant stemmed from an investigation following an incident reported to authorities on Feb. 1, according to police. item.title: New Construction Planned for Pocconock Trail
item.description: The municipal Building Department on Feb. 13 received an application for a 5,380-square-foot house in southeastern New Canaan. The six-bedroom home planned for 15 Pocconock Trail will include six full bathrooms, one half-bath, three fireplaces, finished basement and attic and a three-bay garage. item.title: Town Approves Contract for Improving Route 106/Farm Road Intersection
item.description: Municipal officials on Tuesday approved a $14,500 contract with a New Haven-based engineering firm to advance the town’s plans for fixing a major traffic problem in New Canaan.
